worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.summary: Compress all power into one piercing beam: enemies in the corridor are punched through together, and standing in a line is punished; the user is left spent afterwards, unable to act or move.
The beam pierces every target in the corridor for about %1$s special damage each.
It punches through up to %1$s bodies, settled nearest first, and reaches %2$s blocks; a wall stops it, and targets whose line is blocked by a wall are not pierced.
The corridor is %1$s blocks half-wide; the wind-up is %2$s.
After firing, the user is spent for %1$s, unable to act or move; each extra body punched through adds %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.use.1: Punch through several enemies in a line
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.use.2: Trade a long spent window for one piercing shot
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.preference.f: On: narrow the beam into a longer lance - more reach and higher single-target damage, but easier to miss side-by-side foes and a longer spent window. Off: a wider beam that catches clustered foes more easily, shorter range and slightly less damage, and a shorter spent window.
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.preference.a: How many bodies must line up before the companion fires. Higher saves the beam for queues; at 1 it fires at a single target too.
Below this health fraction the companion stops firing (unless the target is nearly down). Higher avoids leaving a spent opening.
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.timing: A longer wind-up and a quick recovery; the spent window settles after the beam, growing with each body pierced.
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.growth.0: From level 34 the beam gains another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.hyperbeam.growth.1: From level 54 it steps up again.
